title: Join Now
text: Once Supreme Duel begins, all Lords across 16 Kingdoms with Sanctuaries Lv.20+ are eligible to register and compete.

title: Grand Celebration
text: During the registration phase, earn Supreme Fireworks from Daily Quest Chests. Donate your Supreme Fireworks to celebrate the grand event across all 16 Kingdoms and earn Recluse Coins as reward.

title: Seeded Player
text: Lords ranked in the top 8 of their Kingdom's Hero total Might Rankings will be automatically designated as seeded contestants upon registration.

title: Abundant Events
text: Brave Lords from 16 Kingdoms will face off across multiple rounds, defeat opponents to claim massive rewards, and compete for ultimate supreme glory.

title: Prediction Reward
text: When the Event reaches the Rematch and Elimination Phases, a Prediction activity will unlock—support your favorite contestants and earn generous rewards!

title: Battle to the End
text: In the Elimination Phase, each contestant competes in 3 matches, requiring 2 wins to advance. In the Finals, each contestant competes in 5 matches, requiring 3 wins to claim victory.

title: Single Elimination
text: During Elimination, a single defeat results in immediate elimination. You cannot participate in subsequent matches.

title: Points Rules
text: Battles use the highest Level Soldiers available when the contestant's Lineup was saved. For each opponent's Lv.N Soldier defeated (including lightly wounded, heavily wounded, or defeated), (1+N)×6 points will be granted. For each of your Lv.N Soldiers surviving a battle, (1+N)×9 points will be granted. Your battle points equal the sum of both.

title: Grand Celebration Reset
text: When Preliminaries begin, all rewards from Grand Celebration will reset. Donate your Supreme Fireworks generously to earn Recluse Coins.

title: Elite Gathering
text: The top 2 contestants in each Rematch group will advance to the Elimination phase.

title: Best of Three
text: Each contestant's Rematch consists of 3 battles. Win 2 out of 3 to secure victory.

title: Relay Matches
text: During Rematch Phase, a contestant will face 2 opponents daily for the first three days, then 1 opponent since day four. All contestants will face each other once during Rematch phase.

title: 3V3 Deathmatch
text: After contestants are matched, they will use virtual Soldiers and engage in 3v3 battles. The contestant that wins will advance to the next round, until all his/her squads are eliminated. Attacker/Defender roles are randomly assigned.
